specification.objective: Correct site accessibility text scaling so untouched and reset states retain the exact platform-provided TextScaler behavior, while user adjustments compose with that scaler instead of linearizing it. This follow-up supersedes the text-scaling interpretation in site-accessibility-tools-v1.

requirements.statement: Before any user adjustment and after restoring defaults, the accessibility wrapper preserves the incoming TextScaler behavior, including nonlinear scaling across font sizes.
While a user adjustment is active, the selected multiplier composes with each incoming scaled font size without replacing the platform scaler's nonlinear behavior.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A widget regression with a deliberately nonlinear incoming TextScaler verifies its outputs at multiple font sizes before adjustment and after reset.
The same widget regression verifies that active text-size adjustment multiplies the nonlinear scaler's outputs at multiple font sizes.

invariants.statement: When the adjustment is 100%, the incoming platform TextScaler is passed through unchanged, including after reset.
The adjustment changes only the output of the incoming TextScaler and does not linearize or replace its per-font-size scaling behavior.

forbidden_states.statement: A nonlinear platform TextScaler is replaced by a linear TextScaler before adjustment or after reset.
An active user multiplier is applied to one estimated scale factor rather than to each font-size-specific scaled output.

inputs.statement: The TextScaler provided by the surrounding MediaQuery and the user's accessibility text-size adjustment.

outputs.statement: The original TextScaler when the user multiplier is 100%, or a composed TextScaler while the user multiplier is active.

failure_semantics.statement: On the locked baseline, the regression fails with the literal marker a11y_scaler_composition_missing because the nonlinear incoming TextScaler is reduced to a linear scale.

argv: import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run(['flutter','test','test/accessibility_tools_test.dart','--plain-name','accessibility settings preserve nonlinear platform text scaling'],cwd='frontend'); print('a11y_scaler_composition_missing' if r.returncode else 'a11y_scaler_composition_present'); sys.exit(r.returncode)
